import pandas as pd
p='airlines/B6.csv'; df=pd.read_csv(p)
# all IDs appearing more than once
counts=df['flight_id'].value_counts()
dup_ids=sorted(counts[counts>1].index.tolist())
sub=df[(df['date']=='2025-02-14') & (df['cancelled']==True)].copy()
# unique IDs, preserve first appearance/order in filtered data
ids=sub['flight_id'].drop_duplicates().tolist()
print('duplicate ids',dup_ids)
print('duplicate counts',counts[counts>1].to_dict())
print('matching rows\n',sub.to_string(index=False))
print('unique matching',len(ids),ids)
# show duplicated IDs details in target/date perhaps
print('target dup records',sub[sub.flight_id.duplicated(keep=False)].to_string(index=False))
